summary: Practise stakeholder mapping, negotiation, and persuasive communication for cross-functional work. Explore the 5-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Influencing without authority is the practice of gaining cooperation when you need action from colleagues who do not report to you. For project leads, specialists, and cross-functional professionals, the course develops stakeholder mapping, persuasive proposals, and interest-based negotiation to move shared work forward. You practise handling objections, choosing responses to conflict, and recording clear commitments for follow-up across remote, hybrid, and other workplace collaboration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need cooperation across reporting lines, functions, or project teams. It suits foundation-level learners seeking practical tools for day-to-day influence conversations.
prerequisites: No specialist qualification is specified. Familiarity with workplace projects or cross-functional tasks will help you apply the exercises; no coding or programming is required.
